title: Chapter 186 Talents
content:
Chapter 186 Talents

"Since you two have no objections, I will go and ask Captain Li for instructions. The Captain will decide everything."

Tu Si and Zhai Chong have been tied up and tied up in the house. Zhai Chong stared at the smiling Xu Yang, wishing he could eat his meat raw, but his mouth was also tied up with a cloth, and he could only let out a hoarse whimper. .

He thought in frustration: "Heifu Baijiang, we are so incompetent that we were tricked by this army thief."

Zhai Chong admired Heifu's words, "If you don't enter the tiger's den, you won't get the tiger's cubs." He believed that Heifu was trying to make the breakout smoother, to make his side more certain to win, and to save fewer lives, so he resolutely left the city and personally Fake surrender. This is something that only a man of great wisdom and courage cannot do. Xu Yang is completely judging the heart of a gentleman with the heart of a villain.

But Zhai Chong is helpless now. He and Tu Si's soldiers are stationed on the city wall. Now that they are not around, once Xu Yang gets the tiger talisman in Li You's hand and can legitimately command everyone, it will be all over!

Zhai Chong was filled with regret. Why hadn't he noticed this man's viper-like heart before?

Heifu handed the tiger talisman to Li You, but as soon as he left the city, Li You, who was still awake, developed a fever and was half asleep. Xu Yang had just "visited" Li You and found that he was already talking nonsense. Then he came up with the idea of seizing Li You and the tiger charm, and then running away with a few cronies.

Xu Yang still had fresh memories of the Qin army's defeat in Xiangcheng that night. The collapsed army formation and the Qin soldiers scattered in all directions. He was stunned by this scene. After experiencing that night, he had no relationship with Chu at all. Jun didn't have the courage to fight to the death, and just wanted to escape back quickly.

This person is not good at external warfare, but he is good at internal strife and speculation. In Xu Yang's opinion, whether he can control Li You is the key to success. When Li You woke up halfway, he made up the lie that a black man came to Chu, led the Chu people to attack the city, and that he had to fight to the death to rescue him. Anyway, the people left in the city were all dead prisoners, and the rest were his own. Confidant, no one came to expose him.

After making up his mind, Xu Yang ignored the two dying men, Zhai Chong and Tu Si. He asked a few of his confidants to stay here, and told him: "When I leave the city with the captain, I will leave the house with everyone." , it was set on fire!"

Xu Yang is ruthless and will never stop doing anything. Even if they don't cooperate, the fewer people who know about it, the easier it will be to make it true!

Then, Xu Yang walked outside, looked at Man who was frightened after being controlled by his cronies, and said with a smile: "It seems that General Man Bai is still aware of current affairs."

He said hurriedly: "As long as Mr. Xu can take his subordinates out of here, I am willing to obey Mr. Xu's order."

They gathered hundreds of Nanjun generals along the way. Because he knew that he was not a short-handed personal guard, he had always been a marginalized person, taciturn, and was polite to Heifu and Xu Yang. With Xu Yang completely controlling the situation, Man wisely chose to cooperate.

"I am willing to go forward for General Xu Bai and drive away the soldiers guarding Captain Li."

Most of Xu Yang's men were lost in the defeat, and now there are only thirty or forty men available. They may not be able to compete with Heifu's men guarding Li You, so he needs a collaborator.

But in response to Man's invitation to fight, Xu Yang smiled lightly and did not believe it.

Because Man was also from Nanjun, he might favor Heifu more. If he turned against him, Xu Yang couldn't bear the consequences.

"General Man Bai, please stay with me, let your people clear the way, take us to the courtyard, and welcome Captain Li out!"

According to Xu Yang's plan, when they were fighting together, he would rush into the courtyard with his cronies and rob Li You who was still awake.

In this way, he could retreat without spending a single soldier, leaving behind a fire that burned Zhai Chong and Tu Si to death, making the situation even more chaotic. Let the people of Chu take their time in this endgame. Clean it up!

Just when Xu Yang thought he had a plan and began to prepare a plan to seize Li You, in a corner in the distance, a shadow quietly shrank back...

…

Heifu divided his men into two. One half was led by Huaimu and guarded the Chu army at the top of the city. The other half was led by Dongmen Bao and guarded Li You's side and could not leave even half a step.

He also knew that Li You was fine when he was awake, but once Li You became unconscious due to a wound attack, then whoever controls Li You controls the power to command everyone!

In the courtyard, Dongmen Bao, Gong Ao, Li Xian and others were a little surprised when they heard what Ji Ying came to tell them.

"Are you telling the truth? Neither Zhai Baijiang nor Tu Baijiang have come out yet."

"Not only did he not come out, I also saw that Xu Yang left someone to guard outside the house. I think he has detained two generals!"

Keep an eye on Xu Yang when he leaves the city and pretends to surrender. This is the task given to Ji Ying by Hei Fu. He does not trust this general who is always disobedient to him and has repeatedly raised objections. But is there any reason to kill this person? After all, Xu Yang He is Li You's old subordinate, and he is much more senior than himself.

Sure enough, as soon as Hei Fu left, Xu Yang found an excuse to "visit" Li You. After finding that Li You was not very awake, he left in a hurry.

From that moment on, Ji Ying led two smart men to follow him from afar, and then he discovered Xu Yang's conspiracy.

"Now Xu Yang is mobilizing his cronies, as well as the Hundred General's men, walking towards this direction. There are fifty people, about the same as us. They will be here in half a moment. Ah Bao, you are the commander of the village. What do you say? what to do?"

The commander of the village, Dongmen Bao, was a rough guy. Without saying a word, he rolled up his sleeves and said, "Dare you plot evil? Follow me and kill them all!"

"promise!"

As soon as these words came out, everyone was gearing up. Not only had their order and morale been well cultivated by Hei Fu, but in terms of fierceness, no one in the Nanjun soldiers could compare with them. Even Hei Fu praised them as "talented men", which means He is a brave man.

Li Xian, the commander on the side, spoke up: "No, what if Xu Yang sent people to kidnap the captain when we all came out, wouldn't it be bad? Besides, the hundred generals planned to fake a surrender, and then led their troops out of the city to fight with When the Chu people are fighting, if hundreds of generals do not return, but there is a fire and chaos in the city first, giving the Chu people outside the city an opportunity to take advantage of, then won’t the plan of the hundreds of generals be in vain? I’m afraid we will all be killed by the Chu people. captive."

Everyone looked at each other: "What should we do?"

Li Xian touched his chin, pondered for a moment and then said, "I do have an idea."

Everyone also knew that although Li Xian was only a minor due to his title, he was highly regarded by Hei Fu and often discussed matters with him. In the eyes of everyone, Li Xian had some plans, so they asked him to tell him quickly.

"First, the Hundred Generals have long told us to be careful to guard against this person, so we knew that Xu Yang was planning something evil, but he didn't know that we were already prepared and noticed his conspiracy, so we used darkness to confront the light. "

"Secondly, Xu Yang brought people here because he wanted two things. One is the tiger talisman. With the tiger talisman, he can command everyone legitimately; the other is Captain Li. Bu Cheng said that the captain is now mentally unstable. Qing, I am afraid that Xu Yang wants to snatch the captain from us and use the tiger symbol to command everyone. Although we still don’t know what he wants to do. Is he surrendering? Or escaping? But it is not good for the strategy of hundreds of generals and must be stopped. !”

Everyone heard what he said was reasonable and nodded, waiting for Li Xian's solution to the situation.

Li Xian smiled and said: "Just imagine, second and third sons, what if Captain Li wakes up at this time? Then no matter what Xu Yang plans to do, even if he holds several hundred generals hostage, it will all come to nothing!"

"But the captain didn't wake up." Ji Ying muttered.

Gong Ao, who is also a senior officer, also said at the side: "Yes, Bu Cheng said that the captain has started talking nonsense and can't wake up at all."

"Only we know whether the captain is awake or not. How can outsiders know?"

Li Xian said, "My idea is to send someone with a fake military order to tell Xu Yang that the captain is awake and to summon him immediately and ask him to come over quickly!"

"In this way, Xu Yang's plans can be disrupted and he will not dare to act rashly!"

Li Xian gestured: "Come, let him close the door and beat the dog! If he doesn't come, he is disobedient and disrespectful. We can use the command of the captain and hold the tiger talisman to divide the subordinates of Zhai Baijiang and Tu Baijiang." Half of the people guard the city wall, and the other half join us to kill the traitor Xu Yang. It is better than these fifty people to fight against them. With the enemy outnumbered, they can be wiped out quickly, and there will be no chaos in the city. A major event for hundreds of generals.”

"What a great idea!" Everyone praised, and then decided that Ji Ying would inform other people on the city wall to come over quickly.

But then the problem came again.

"Who is going to inform Xu Yang about this?"

Everyone was silent for a while. After a while, Dongmen Bao was about to slap his chest and respond, but was stopped by Gong Ao next to him.

"A Bao, what did General Bai say when he left the city? As the commander of the village, you should be here to stay. How can you leave without permission?"

Gong Ao's words were still unpleasant. He, a senior official, actually scolded his immediate superior in public. You know, the village chief has the power to execute senior officials...

Dongmen Leopard suddenly became furious, glared at Li Xian and Gong Ao, and shouted: "This village chief is too lazy. One of the chiefs is smarter than me, and the other chief wants to compete with me in bravery. It's really I'm so angry. Do you know that I owe the captain my life? If I don't pay it back now, how long will it take?"

Hearing this, Gong Ao burst into laughter.

"Ah Bao, Ah Bao, you owe General Bai one life, but I owe two! Who owes more?"

Dongmen Leopard was speechless for a moment, so everyone decided that Gong Ao would fake the order of the captain.

Time was running out. Li Xian followed the format of Heifu's orders he had seen before. He hurriedly wrote a sentence on the slip and stuffed it into a bamboo tube. However, he hesitated when handing it to Gong Ao.

He had always disliked Gong Ao. He thought he was causing trouble everywhere and was unsociable. Sometimes he even expected him to die in battle.

But now it seems that this person is not useless.

Li Xian was not very sure whether Xu Yang would be fooled and fall into the trap obediently. Therefore, most of those who went there would have a narrow escape from death, and the risk was greater than that of Heifu going out of the city to fake surrender.

"Gong Ao, if things don't work out... you..."

In that case, Gong Ao will definitely die!

"If it happens, everything will be easy to talk about."

Gong Ao, this young man from Yancheng, who was younger than Heifu, didn't seem to know what fear was. He took the sealed bamboo tube, refused the armor handed to him by the robes, only hung the sword on his waist, and then He stuffed a dagger into the side of his boots, and then said with a relaxed smile:

"The Hundred Generals said it well, if you don't enter the tiger's den, you won't catch the tiger's cubs! If things don't work out, I will do what Zhuan Zhu did!"
